## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Arnsberg, Germany. It starts at 4 Phoenixplatz.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> At Phoenix des Lumières, visitors are immersed in a constantly evolving world of art and creativity. This unique digital art space offers a captivating experience where light, sound, and visual storytelling come together to transform iconic artworks into dynamic, larger-than-life displays.
>
> Whether you’re a first-time visitor or returning to explore new exhibitions, there is always something special to see, with cutting-edge projections and mesmerizing soundscapes creating a fully immersive journey.
>
> Current exhibition: The Kingdom of the Pharaohs, The French Orientalists, and Foreign Nature.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.01. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 186 ratings and 57 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
